source_record.statement: Review is a primary Assistant mode with Single Agent and Multi-Pass Review submenu choices.

source_record.statement: Single Agent creates a fresh-context reviewer subagent with selected model and Persona.

rows.new_proof: One selected model/Persona slot, one distinct local attempt, frozen input with no peer findings.
rows.remaining: Recorded example, not a real fresh-context provider subagent.

source_record.statement: Multi-Pass supports 1–8 reviewers with default 3 and permits repeated model choices.

rows.new_proof: One and three reviewers; three same-model slots remain distinct; prior roster edits preserved.
rows.remaining: The full 1–8 reviewer/configuration space is not recorded here.

source_record.statement: Every initial review pass receives a unique attempt and frozen target pack.

rows.new_proof: Unique attempt IDs, shared immutable target snapshot and per-pass hash bindings.
rows.remaining: Local demo checksum, not a production cryptographic pack or isolated provider session.

source_record.statement: Initial review passes run concurrently and blind.

rows.new_proof: All local initial pass slots are admitted together with no peer identities or findings.
rows.remaining: Results are replayed recorded observations; native parallel execution/isolation remains unproven.

source_record.statement: Findings are normalized for likely duplicates without losing origin/evidence.

rows.new_proof: Four raw observations normalize to three findings; duplicate IDs, both originating reviewers and evidence refs survive.
rows.remaining: Broader semantic duplicate detection remains a provider/runtime obligation.

source_record.statement: Reviewers then corroborate findings using confirm, reject, duplicate or uncertain dispositions.

rows.new_proof: Structured peer dispositions and confidence/evidence; failed, waived, replaced and retried attempts cannot vote against old passes.
rows.remaining: Not every disposition is a separate user-visible workflow; live corroboration is not executed.

source_record.statement: Final adjudication preserves unresolved material disagreement rather than manufacturing consensus.

rows.new_proof: Confirmed ranking finding retains uncertain dissent and its reason; uncertain performance suggestion is retained.
rows.remaining: Provider adjudication quality is not inferred from deterministic recorded examples.

source_record.statement: Reviews of different target hashes cannot silently merge.

rows.new_proof: Wrong hash, stale epoch/assignment/attempt refused; stale participant completion cannot finalize.
rows.remaining: Cross-machine target changes and real project state monitoring are not implemented here.

source_record.statement: Review output is a versioned Rich/Markdown artifact plus concise thread summary.

rows.new_proof: One frozen V1 report with Rich/Markdown views, stable left tab, explicit Markdown file export, concise linked card.
rows.remaining: General artifact retention, persistent restart and later report versions are not demonstrated.

source_record.statement: Review is read-only and never automatically repairs target work.

rows.new_proof: Frozen target bytes and read-only report stay unchanged; no automatic task creation, source mutation or repair.
rows.remaining: Native tool/permission enforcement is outside this concept.

source_record.statement: Confirmed findings can be explicitly sent to agent or converted to To-Dos.

rows.new_proof: Selected confirmed findings create actual pending owner To-Dos with lineage; task links reopen the finding. Send drafts without dispatch or overwriting existing text.
rows.remaining: Agent dispatch and production persistence remain separate; only multi conversion is recorded.
